uso: Dado, cara 1 (bandejas, chat de revelación, apuesta actual; 24-96 px).
prompt: A single six-sided die seen almost straight from above so the TOP FACE is large and square-on, with only a hint of the two lit side faces (very slight 3/4 bevel). Die of translucent smoked resin with a soft internal glow, chamfered corners, tiny internal circuitry lines; the pips are glowing cyan (#2ad4ff) inset dots. Pips are VERY LARGE, bold and high-contrast so they read at 24 px. Standard pip layout. No shadow, no ground, no text, no numerals. Centered with generous margin. The top face shows exactly 1 pip (one large centered pip).

uso: Mia/Meyer: cubilete tapando los dados.
prompt: A brushed-chrome cylindrical dice cup with a thin glowing cyan neon strip around the rim. Shown standing upside down covering the dice, 3/4 view from slightly above. No shadow, no table.

uso: Mia/Meyer: cubilete levantado al revelar.
prompt: A brushed-chrome cylindrical dice cup with a thin glowing cyan neon strip around the rim. The same cup tilted and lifted about 35 degrees, mouth toward the viewer, dark empty interior. Identical materials, scale and style to the closed cup. No dice, no shadow, no table.

uso: Fondo de la zona de juego (dados y estado).
prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Dark matte carbon-fibre surface with extremely faint cyan grid lines, flat lighting. Flat lighting so it tiles, no objects, low contrast, no vignette.

uso: Fondo de paneles de lectura: formulario de partida y mensajes de chat.
prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Dark smoked-glass panel with barely visible scanlines and a faint hex grid, very low contrast. Completely free of text, folds that break the tile and vignette; very low contrast so text on top stays readable.

uso: Marcos, bordes y fondo de las cabeceras de ventana.
prompt: Seamless tileable texture. Dark brushed metal with fine scratches and a few hex bolts. Flat lighting so it tiles, low contrast, no dominant features.

uso: Adorno de esquina de las ventanas (se gira por CSS a las 4 esquinas).
prompt: A corner ornament for a frame, TOP-LEFT orientation, arms running along the top and left edges: chrome corner bracket with a thin glowing cyan line along both arms. Arms end cleanly at the canvas edges (touching the top and left edge is allowed for THIS asset), transparent elsewhere. Matches the palette and materials of the skin.

uso: Separador horizontal entre secciones.
prompt: A thin horizontal divider, perfectly symmetric left-right: a thin glowing cyan neon line with a small diamond in the exact centre. Readable on both dark and light backgrounds.

uso: Barra de título de las ventanas (se estira a lo ancho).
prompt: A window title-bar strip: brushed dark-metal strip with a thin glowing cyan line along the bottom edge. The middle 80 % must be plain with NO focal features so it can stretch and tile horizontally; left and right edges must tile horizontally.

uso: Botón principal (Subir, Anunciar, Iniciar partida).
prompt: A flat button plate texture, rectangle edge to edge: dark glass plate with a glowing cyan neon border. Completely empty in the centre (text goes there), no ornament in the middle, no text. Same construction, lighting and detail level as the other two button plates.

uso: Botón «¡Mentira!» / «¡Dudo!».
prompt: A flat button plate texture, rectangle edge to edge: dark glass plate with a glowing magenta-red neon border. Completely empty in the centre (text goes there), no ornament in the middle, no text. Same construction, lighting and detail level as the other two button plates.

uso: Botón secundario (Calzar, Acepto).
prompt: A flat button plate texture, rectangle edge to edge: dark glass plate with a dim steel-grey border. Completely empty in the centre (text goes there), no ornament in the middle, no text. Same construction, lighting and detail level as the other two button plates.

uso: Contador de dados/vidas que quedan (sustituye a ★ y ♥).
prompt: A glowing cyan energy-cell capsule, sleek, with a bright core. Bold simple shape, thick readable silhouette, readable at 24 px.

uso: Dado/vida perdida (se muestra apagado junto a los que quedan).
prompt: The same capsule dead: dark, cracked glass, no glow. Same size, angle and style as `vida.png`.

uso: Moneda suelta (entradas, premios).
prompt: A hexagonal metal credit token with a thin glowing line across it (no text, no numerals). Bold rim, readable at 24 px.

uso: Bote de la partida.
prompt: A small sealed chrome data case, slightly open with a cyan glow inside. Bold silhouette, readable at 32 px.

uso: Fondo de escena para jugar (opcional): el GM lo pone como imagen de la escena.
prompt: Top-down black glass holo-gaming table with a faint glowing grid, a glowing drink and a few credit tokens near the OUTER edges only, neon reflections. The central 60 % of the picture is clear, calm and low-contrast so game tokens read perfectly on top. Slight dark vignette at the corners. No text, no characters.

uso: Imagen principal de la skin: ficha del módulo y selector. ¡Es la referencia de estilo!
prompt: HERO EMBLEM (still life, no characters): Two translucent glowing dice floating above a credit token inside a thin neon ring, wet reflections below. Centered compact composition, rich painterly detail, no text, no background.
